checks.explanation: The selection disclosure is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The basic services includes text names an arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits and authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
The list shows only the basic services fee as a mandatory overhead fee and no second fee for facilities, staff or handling.
The embalming disclosure is on page 1 and the embalming price is on page 1, so it is on the same page.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket service without viewing.
The alternative-container disclosure is on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2, so it is on the same page.
No text states that a casket is required for direct cremation; purchaser-provided and fiberboard options are listed.
The direct cremation entries have no description of what the price includes and no mention of a crematory cash advance.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have their own priced lines and no other offered goods lack a price.
The list offers no optional combination package; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not counted as packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase beyond the wording of required disclosures.
No text claims that goods or services delay decomposition or protect the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure and no required disclosure is printed in a way that is hard to notice.
